name: whitaker-plumbing
description: Whitaker Plumbing website — Next.js frontend, NestJS API, SQLite database

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
